suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single "nit:" comment.
I'm thankful for the mamak still open when the office WiFi finally died on me at 11pm.
I'm grateful for catching the one missing semicolon before the client demo, not during it.
I'm thankful for my mom packing extra rendang even after I told her I'd eat out.
I'm grateful for the LRT actually showing up on time on the one day I overslept.
I'm thankful for the office gone quiet enough that the Jira board finally looks manageable.
I'm grateful for a manager who said "take the day" without making me explain why.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak that still tastes the way it used to, price hikes aside.
I'm grateful for the breeze right after Maghrib when the heat of the day finally lets go.
I'm thankful for a rollback script that actually worked the one time I needed it.
I'm grateful for an old kampung friend texting out of nowhere just to check in.
I'm thankful for the mamak uncle getting my order right without me repeating it twice.
I'm grateful for a long weekend that lined up with Raya this year.
I'm thankful for a senior engineer staying back an extra hour to walk me through code nobody bothered to document.
I'm grateful for waking up before the alarm, just in time for Subuh, with nothing rushed about it.
